description.en: Client-side IRI remap for UI traversal metadata moved from archimate-lite 2.3.1 into package archimate-ui-traversal 1.0.0. Knowledge-core does not rewrite IRIs; clients that cached old UI metadata IRIs should apply this map before reading the new package.
description.cs: Klientské přemapování IRI pro UI traversal metadata přesunutá z archimate-lite 2.3.1 do package archimate-ui-traversal 1.0.0. Jádro KC IRI nepřepisuje; klient, který zná stará IRI UI metadat, nejdřív aplikuje tuto mapu.

notes: ArchiMate element/relationship/view IRIs under archimate-lite remain unchanged.

Do not import archimate-lite@3.0.0 over an existing 2.3.1 release (compat_breaking: UI objects absent). On 2.3.1 installs, import archimate-ui-traversal@1.0.0 additively and use this map for client caches; prefer fresh installs with lite 3.0.0 + UI 1.0.0.
New class UiTraversalMeta replaces ArchiMateLiteMeta as parent of Ui* classes; there is no from→to for UiTraversalMeta.
Shape codes (aml-ui-*) are unchanged; packageCode ownership moves to archimate-ui-traversal.
Prefix rule for stable iriLocal: replace iriBase archimate-lite/ with archimate-ui-traversal/ for listed locals.
